== Biography ==
{{Ireland Native}}
David was born about 1836. He was the son of Thomas Glasgow, farmer, Killycurragh.
<ref name="mar"/>

On 27 Aug 1857 at Orritor Presbyterian, Kildress, he married Margaret Bell(17), daughter of farmer William Bell of Ballynasollus, Kildress.
<ref name="mar">[https://civilrecords.irishgenealogy.ie/churchrecords/details-civil/fe85133265341 David Glasgow, Margaret Bell, 25 Aug 1857, Cookstown] at Irish Civil Registration - Marriages</ref>

As of 1901 they lived at Killycurragh with children Richard and Sarah Jane.
<ref>[http://www.census.nationalarchives.ie/pages/1901/Tyrone/Oritor/Killycurragh/1729680/ 1901 census] - Residents of a house 29 in Killycurragh (Oritor, Tyrone). David(65), Margaret(59)</ref>

In 1911 they were guardian of a child, Agnes Ferguson(9).

He passed away 16 Apr 1915 at his residence in Killycurragh, age 77, witness:  John Glasgow . <ref>PRONI Will Calendars: "Probate of the Will of David Glasgow late of Killycurragh County Tyrone Farmer who died 16 April 1915 granted at Armagh to John Glasgow and Richard Glasgow Farmers."</ref>
<ref>[https://www.britishnewspaperarchive.co.uk/viewer/bl/0002006/19150424/094/0005 "Mr. David Glasgow, Killycurragh"], ''Mid-Ulster Mail'' - Saturday 24 April 1915, Page 5</ref>
He was interred in Cookstown Cemetery, plot OP/E/30.
<ref>[https://www.britishnewspaperarchive.co.uk/viewer/bl/0002006/19150424/003/0001 "Deaths - Glasgow"], ''Mid-Ulster Mail'' - Saturday 24 April 1915, Page 1</ref>
<ref>[[Space:Forthill_Cemetery%2C_Cookstown%2C_Tyrone|Forthill Cemetery, Cookstown, Tyrone]] - OP/E/30.</ref>


== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-1684]] is assessed at 96% (proved). David's 1857 marriage account names Thomas Glasgow, farmer, Killycurragh. His compatible 1836 generation and locality identify the selected father strongly; the other David marrying Mary is expressly distinguished by a different father.

Selected Glasgow-1684 fatherhood of Glasgow-1644; maternal identity and upstream ancestry are separate.

Next useful test: Read original 1857 marriage for father and witnesses.

Source basis already held: [https://civilrecords.irishgenealogy.ie/churchrecords/details-civil/fe85133265341 On 27 Aug 1857 at Orritor Presbyterian, Kildress, he married Margaret Bell(17), daughter of farmer William Bell of Ballynasollus, Kildress.  David Glasgow, Margaret Bell, 25 Aug 1857, Cookstown (https://civilrecords.irishgenealogy.ie/churchrecords/details-civil/fe85133265341) at Irish Civil Registration - Marriages]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.


There is a newspaper obituary but it doesn't list the funeral mourners unfortunately.

=== Other David Glasgows ===
[[Glasgow-1647 | David Glasgow]] of Killycurragh of similar age, marries Mary Glasgow in 1859. Clearly different people as David and Mary go on to have children; and the other one has a different father on the marriage record.

[[Glasgow-692|David Glasgow (abt.1833-)]] of Beltonanean, marries Margaret Jane Glasgow of Ballynasollus in 1878.

Another David Glasgow of Ballynasollus (b abt 1845):
* [http://www.census.nationalarchives.ie/pages/1901/Tyrone/Ballynasollus/Ballynasollus/1730429/ 1901 census], age 55, wife Mary(60), one son James(14) - Catholic
* [https://civilrecords.irishgenealogy.ie/churchrecords/details-civil/2cb05210292891 James birth record] matching on date: - parents David Glasgow of Bellivina & Mary McCullagh.
